text: `signext`/`zeroext` shall apply only to supported integer signature entries and prescribe sign/zero extension where a wider physical carrier is used. They shall not alter logical integer widths, memory encodings, or insert logical body casts. Unsupported/non-integer/conflicting attributes shall be rejected.
